judgement.code: const gEvery = (L, test) => inArmy(L, () => L.units.filter(u => unitRules(u).some(test) && !Object.keys(u.partialRules || {}).some(test)));   // (partialRules: label → the model that has it)

source.implements: units with Deep Strike, Scouts or Infiltrators: only when every model of the unit has it (24.09, 24.31; Infiltrators: "if every model in a unit has this ability"), as the Overview counts them
